title: The Night Owls Speakeasy at Prismajic
venue_description:
The Night Owls Speakeasy - Lakewood's Creative Music Venue

The Night Owls Speakeasy is an intimate creative arts venue located within Prismajic at Colorado Mills Mall in Lakewood Colorado. Operating as both a cocktail bar and live entertainment space The Night Owls brings together the power of immersive art music and creative expression in a uniquely designed mystical setting.

Prismajic's Creative Mission

Prismajic has been building immersive experiences for corporate clients and the public since 2013 under its original name Artistry Events & Design. The company's core mission is bringing the power of immersive art to everyone through innovative experiences. The Night Owls represents an evolution of this mission into a public-facing entertainment venue.

The Night Owls Concept

The Night Owls is a beautiful speakeasy that emphasizes live music comedy and other local acts in an intimate small venue setting. The speakeasy design creates a cozy judgment-free space where creativity flows and good vibes reign. The venue hosts open mic nights jam sessions and live entertainment events with a focus on supporting local artists and performers.

Drinks & Amenities

Full cocktail bar serving craft spirits and expertly made cocktails. Non-alcoholic mocktails available. Light fare food options. The carefully curated speakeasy aesthetic creates an atmosphere distinct from typical music venues with mystical lighting and creative décor that align with Prismajic's immersive arts focus.

Entertainment Programming

The Night Owls hosts regular open mic and jam nights welcoming musicians comedians poets storytellers and other creative performers. All genres and all talent levels are welcome. The venue serves as a gathering place for Lakewood's creative community providing performance opportunities for emerging and experienced artists.

Venue Versatility

In addition to The Night Owls Prismajic operates Shiki Dreams an immersive experience and The Woods a 1900 square foot hidden event venue. This multi-venue approach within Prismajic allows for hosting diverse creative events from intimate performances to larger productions.
